allow: PowerShell($env:PORT=3100; Start-Job -Name webstart -ScriptBlock { Set-Location "C:\\Users\\user\\Desktop\\inova flow\\apps\\web"; $env:PORT=3100; npx next start -p 3100 } | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 9; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3100/login" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output "STATUS: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; Write-Output "HAS_FORM: $\($r.Content -match 'Entrar na plataforma'\)"; Write-Output "HAS_EMPRESA: $\($r.Content -match 'Empresa'\)"; Write-Output "LEN: $\($r.Content.Length\)" } catch { Write-Output "ERR: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $l = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3100/login" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output "LOGIN has loader: $\($l.Content -match 'Verificando sess'\)" } catch { Write-Output "ERR $_" }; foreach \($p in @\('/','/inbox','/crm','/leads','/agenda','/knowledge','/followups','/team','/settings'\)\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3100$p" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 20; $leak = \($r.Content -match 'Maria Silva'\) -or \($r.Content -match 'Funil comercial'\) -or \($r.Content -match 'Novos leads'\); Write-Output "$p -> $\($r.StatusCode\) guard=$\($r.Content -match 'Restaurando sess'\) privateLeak=$leak" } catch { Write-Output "$p -> ERR $_" } })
